prerequisites: Competencies taught in the modules Machine Learning and Fundamentals of Statistics are recommended.

learning_outcomes.text: The students can explain aspects of the theory of neural networks, describe various architectures, and discuss the possibilities and limitations of artificial neural networks.
The students can explain concepts of supervised learning and deep learning.
The students are able to design a data-driven solution for artificial neural networks using given program libraries, starting from a concrete problem.
The students are able to apply scientific working methods in independently recognizing, formulating, and solving problems.
The students are able to speak freely about scientific content, both in front of an audience and in a discussion.

syllabus_topics: Possibilities and limitations of the models

assessment_methods.method: Weekly exercise assignments (at least 50% of points achieved)
Oral presentation of the solution to at least two exercise assignments

assessment_rules: To acquire credit points, at least 50 percent of the points from weekly exercise assignments must be achieved, and the solution to at least two exercise assignments must be presented orally. The examination performance is either an oral examination or a written examination. Grading is done with 0 to 15 points according to the examination regulations for the M.Sc. Computer Science degree program.
bibliography: Ian Goodfellow "Deep Learning. Das umfassende Handbuch: Grundlagen, aktuelle Verfahren und Algorithmen, neue Forschungsansätze" MIT Press
Charu C. Aggarwal "Neural Networks and Deep Learning: A Textbook" Springer
